summary: 游戏镜头搭建与调参：2D 跟随的死区和前瞻、第三人称环绕、第一人称视角和分屏，解决镜头滞后、跟随抖动、露出关卡边界、穿墙。 Builds and tunes game cameras, engine-neutral with Godot and Cinemachine 3 mappings: 2D follow with deadzone and look-ahead, third-person orbit, first-person look and split-screen. Use when the camera lags, jitters while following, shows past the level edge, clips through walls or changes with frame rate. Not for shake (`game-feel`) or physics timestep jitter (`physics-tuning`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill camera-systems，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use when the camera lags, jitters while following, shows past the level edge, clips through walls or changes with frame rate.
Follow its sections: Core workflow; Patterns; Gotchas; Related skills.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：game-feel 用 gene_gdsk_game_feel_v1，physics-tuning 用 gene_gdsk_physics_tuning_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
